SETUP + PURPOSE

SETUP:
• Connect Google Sheets credentials
• Select the client's reporting spreadsheet
• Map KPI fields to the appropriate columns
• Replace demo metrics with the client's live data sources
• Configure the final reporting destination (Gmail, Slack, Teams, etc.)
• Replace the Manual Trigger with a Schedule Trigger for automated daily/weekly reporting

PURPOSE:
Automatically collect business metrics, calculate key performance indicators, log historical results, and deliver recurring performance reports without manual reporting work.

WHAT IT DOES:

Automatically generates a centralized KPI report showing leads, hot leads, outreach, replies, booked calls, revenue, conversion rate, reply rate, and hot lead rate.


HOW IT DOES IT:

Pulls business metrics → calculates KPI percentages → appends the results to Google Sheets → sends the completed KPI summary to the designated reporting destination.


WHY PAY FOR IT:

Eliminates repetitive manual reporting, gives decision-makers consistent visibility into business performance, creates a historical KPI record, and makes it easier to identify trends and make faster data-driven decisions.
